fixedDuringVerification: CI: the native PPTX test needed pptxgenjs, which CI did not install; CI now runs npm ci, and elsewhere the test reports itself unrun when the package is missing.
Player: a late reduced-motion change event (switching it off) settled a running delayed build; now only switching it on settles motion.

notRun: Browsers other than Chromium; PowerPoint and Keynote
limits: Regression passes do not establish factual accuracy, fluency or artistic quality.
Visual review was the author's own art direction, not an independent review.
